---
title: "How-to Guides"
---

Task-oriented recipes for maintaining the app. If you're looking to understand *why*
things are built this way instead, see [Explanation](../explanation/index.qmd).

## Regenerate the workout data

`src/daily_dose/data/workouts.json` and `src/daily_dose/www/images/` are generated by
`scripts/build_workouts_data.py`. Re-run it after editing the legacy Rmd source (kept
at `scripts/_rmd_src/`) or the workout photos.

The original photos aren't kept in this repo (325MB of raw phone photos, compressed
down to ~21MB in `www/`). To regenerate from scratch:

1. Install the script's one extra dependency (already in the `dev` extra): `Pillow`.
2. Restore the original photos from the `gh-pages` branch, which still has them:

   ```bash
   git archive gh-pages -- images | tar -x
   ```

3. Run the build script:

   ```bash
   python3 scripts/build_workouts_data.py
   ```

   It parses all five Rmd files, matches dated photos in `images/`, prefers the typed
   entry on any date that has both, and writes the deduplicated result to
   `workouts.json`. It re-encodes every photo it uses as a downsized JPEG
   (~1600px max dimension, quality 82) into `src/daily_dose/www/images/`.

4. Remove the restored source photos — they're not meant to be committed:

   ```bash
   rm -rf images/
   ```

5. Confirm the data is sane:

   ```bash
   uv run pytest tests/test_data.py
   ```

## Update the tutorial screenshots

The screenshots in [Tutorials](../tutorials/index.qmd) are checked-in PNGs, not
generated at build time. To refresh them after a UI change:

1. Launch the app: `shiny run daily_dose.app:app`
2. Install a headless browser once: `pip install playwright && playwright install chromium`
3. Drive the running app with Playwright, screenshotting each state (initial load,
   after clicking **Random Workout** — run it a few times to catch both a text and a
   photo entry — and after clicking **On This Day**).
4. Save the results into `tutorials/assets/`, overwriting the existing files by name.

## Rebuild the docs site

```bash
great-docs build
```

Rebuilds this whole site — homepage from `README.md`, this guide, Explanation, and the
API Reference from `daily_dose.core`'s docstrings — into `great-docs/_site/`.
